tool_args.rationale: The observed base-field, sink-gradient and coupled-lag signatures match the archived spatiotemporal siphon-memory mechanism. The trajectory batch supplies the additional observations needed to identify its five parameters before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter spatiotemporal siphon-memory ODE to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations cannot reliably identify five coupled parameters; the archived mechanism specifies at least eight rows.

considered_alternatives.option: Static siphon or uncoupled relaxation models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot signatures indicate both sink-gradient dependence and coupled transient lag, which these models do not jointly capture.
It does not resolve the coupled ODE parameter ambiguity.
